0022600194.text: The Houston Rockets (7-2, 1st in the Southwest) are 3-1 on the road and coming off a loss in their most recent game, and they will be without Steven Adams (out, calf strain) and possibly Clint Capela (day-to-day, ankle sprain, game-time decision). The Phoenix Suns are 1-5, have lost four straight, and sit 12th in the West and 3rd in the Pacific, 4.5 games back, with Jordan Goodwin (calf), Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery) and Rasheer Fleming (ankle sprain) all out. The teams have no games yet in the 2026-27 season series, while Houston won the 2025-26 series 4-0, including a 119-105 win in Phoenix on April 7, 2026.
